title: Long-range support robustness and observed radar range boundary

notes: Geometric support, not detector accuracy, hardware range specification or a universal sensor ranking. LiDAR support advantage survives observed subgroup checks, but annotation selection, temporal history and the recorded radar boundary limit inference. Four preprocessing hypotheses do not reproduce all publisher LiDAR counts. Published model results are explicitly attributed rather than claimed as new runs.
